Nutrition.untertitel: Diary, micronutrient analysis, and meal planning
Nutrition.ohnePositionen: Without logged items there is nothing to assess.
Nutrition.neuEingefroren: The nutrient values are frozen anew — they will match the new amount.
Nutrition.portionGewaehlt: Portion selected — name, quantity and gram weight are stored with it.
Nutrition.grammDirekt: Direct gram entry — the portion fields stay empty.
Nutrition.nichtsUebernehmen: There is nothing to copy from yesterday for this meal.
Nutrition.referenzHinweis: Reference values apply to healthy adults at rest. Anyone training, ill, pregnant or on medication needs different amounts — this page cannot know that.
Nutrition.profilHinweis: Reference values depend on age and biological sex. Without both, every nutrient shows „profile missing" instead of a percentage — not 0 %.
Nutrition.zukunftText: Nothing logged here yet — that is not an error. As an admin you can look ahead; a day can be logged once it arrives.

Einstellungen.untertitel: Profile — the basis for reference values and daily targets.
Einstellungen.geburtsdatumHinweis: Day.Month.Year — a date, not an age: a stored age is wrong on the next birthday.
Einstellungen.zeitraumHinweis: Both are states in time, hence a start and an end. Reference values for a day depend on whether the day falls within the period.
Einstellungen.beginnEnde: Start and end (Day.Month.Year). An empty end means: still ongoing.
Einstellungen.formelHinweis: Daily targets are calculated from these values.
Einstellungen.zeitraeumeErhalten: Entered pregnancy and lactation periods are stored and preserved.
Einstellungen.freiwillig: {gesetzt} of {gesamt} values — all voluntary, but without them something stays calculated that must stay uncalculated.
Einstellungen.fehlendeFelder: Date of birth, sex, height, weight, activity
Einstellungen.formelHinweisLang: The formula estimates basal metabolic rate and daily needs; from those come the rings in the diary and the reference values of the nutrient assessment. A target is only set once you confirm it.
Einstellungen.schaetzungKeineMessung: An estimate is not a measurement.
Einstellungen.nurWeiblich: They are only shown when the biological sex is „female".
